input: Audit my monthly grocery spending habits

gold.taskTitle: Audit My Monthly Grocery Spending Habits
gold.taskDescription: Review and analyse the user's monthly grocery spending to identify patterns, inefficiencies, and opportunities to save.

questions.title: What is your approximate monthly grocery budget right now?
questions.description: Understanding the current budget or expected spend sets the baseline for the audit.

questions.title: How many people does your grocery shopping cover?
questions.description: Household size directly affects what counts as reasonable or excessive spending.

questions.title: Where do you currently track your grocery purchases?
questions.description: Knowing whether they use bank statements, a spreadsheet, an app, or nothing guides the data-gathering approach.

questions.title: Which stores or platforms do you shop at most often?
questions.description: Identifying the main shopping sources helps locate all relevant spending records.

questions.title: How many months of spending data do you want to audit?
questions.description: The time range determines the scope and how much historical data needs to be pulled.

questions.title: What is the main problem you suspect with your spending?
questions.description: Knowing the suspected issue — overspending, food waste, impulse buys — focuses the audit on what matters most.

questions.title: Do you want to separate groceries from household or personal care items?
questions.description: Many receipts mix food with non-food items; clarifying this determines how granular the categorisation needs to be.
